_curatorNotes: Charged-attack element-application ICD: gcsim charge.go tags it ICDTagExtraAttack / ICDGroupPoleExtraAttack, whose reset timer is 30f (0.5s) with only the first hit of each window applying (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go). Authored as chargedIcdWindow rather than a weapon-type rule in resolveActionIcd: the census is 16 of 19 oracled polearm users, and Xiao, Raiden and Emilie sit on the default. Reachable only while the swing is infused - bare, a polearm charged attack is Physical and applies nothing.

abilities.name: Dominus Lapidis

_curatorNotes: tickCap 15 (tick-cap round, 2026-08-18): gcsim stele.go `resonance()` re-queues itself every 120f for as long as the construct lives, and skill.go creates it with `newStele(1860)` = 31s against the 30s the kit text states. Measured 15 at both C0 and C6; our duration-derived 14 was one short. Authored as a count rather than by nudging the stated 30s duration.

variants.label: Hold
_curatorNotes: resShred trigger migrated to onCast skill 2026-05-09 (F1). Lives on the Hold-E variant so the shield-active gate is naturally scoped: only fires when Hold-E is cast (which is what creates the Jade Shield carrying the RES debuff to nearby enemies). ↻ 2026-08-14: the PHYSICAL half was missing. The element-less entry means all-elemental, so the bar read "All Elemental RES −20%" and stopped there — but gcsim shield.go applies Value: -0.2 across a list that is explicitly Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro/Geo/Anemo/PHYSICAL/Dendro, and the kit text says "Elemental RES and Physical RES". Authored as a second entry with element: 'physical', the same pairing Shenhe Q, Eula hold-E and Venti C1 use. gcsim re-applies the shred every 18f for as long as the shield holds (0 → 1200f); the 20s duration models that continuous coverage, and the shield-drops-early case is not simulable (no enemy/HP state).

Hold E also creates a Stone Stele alongside the Jade Shield. Variant summons[] overrides base, so only Jade Shield is rendered here — the timeline does not show a co-spawned stele on Hold-press. The press-E base entry above carries the Stele rendering and is the canonical case for stele visualisation.

Jade Shield authored as a shield Effect 2026-08-14, replacing the zero-effect `summons[]` stand-in. TL10 absorption from gcsim zz_zhongli.dm.go: shieldPer[9]=0.2304 (23.04% Max HP) + shieldBase[9]=2711.5093; duration from shield.go `c.newShield(shield, 1200)` = 1200f = 20s. `activeDuration: 20` on the variant keeps the hold bar at 20s — without it the bar would fall through to the BASE ability's Stone Stele and draw 30s. 150% absorption efficiency against all elemental and physical DMG is not modelled (no per-element shield-efficiency primitive; same gap class as Diona/Thoma/Kaeya).

`summons: []` is an EXPLICIT override to none, not an oversight. Hold-E does create a Stone Stele alongside the Jade Shield in game, and once the Jade Shield stand-in became a shield Effect this variant had no summons of its own — which would have inherited the base press-E's stele and drawn it at THIS cast's 20s window, a 30s stele rendered 20s. The co-spawned stele stays unmodelled, as it always has been; the declaration just says so out loud now. Modelling it properly needs the stele at its own 30s span alongside a 20s shield, which is the same per-summon-duration work Ineffa/Citlali/Furina flagged.

Stone Stele migrated to summons[] on the base press-E (P3): 30s in-game lifetime (gcsim 1860f = 31s; rounded to 30 to match KQM canonical), 2s resonance tick interval (gcsim 120f). Per-tick damage: 57.6% ATK Geo at TalentLvl 10 (gcsim skillTick mult). A4 Architect of Stone +1.9% maxHP skillFlatDmg modelled on the passive — applies to per-tick damage at calculation time but not visualised on the tick markers themselves (markers carry no damage values).

Multi-stele spawning (C2 max 2 steles, Hold-E spawning a stele alongside Jade Shield) is not modelled. ↻ 2026-08-14: the reason changed — the renderer used to draw summons[0] only, and now draws every entry in summons[], so an ability CAN own two lanes (Ineffa's shield + Birgitta). What is still missing here is different: two live instances of the SAME summon, which needs a per-instance model rather than a second array entry, and a Hold-E entry pairing Jade Shield with a stele. The first-cast rendering is correct; subsequent casts on the same input refresh the same sub-row.
abilities.description:
Every mountain, rock and inch of land is filled with the power of Geo, but those who can wield such powers freely are few and far between.

Press
Commands the power of earth to create a Stone Stele.

Hold
Causes nearby Geo energy to explode, causing the following effects:
·If their maximum number hasn't been reached, creates a Stone Stele.
·Creates a shield of jade. The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Zhongli's Max HP.
·Deals AoE Geo DMG.
·If there are nearby targets with the Geo element, it will drain a large amount of Geo element from a maximum of 2 such targets. This effect does not cause DMG.

Stone Stele
When created, deals AoE Geo DMG.
Additionally, it will intermittently resonate with other nearby Geo constructs, dealing Geo DMG to nearby opponents.
The Stone Stele is considered a Geo construct that can both be climbed and used to block attacks.
Only one Stele created by Zhongli himself may initially exist at any one time.

Jade Shield
Possesses 150% DMG Absorption against all Elemental and Physical DMG.
Characters protected by the Jade Shield will decrease the Elemental RES and Physical RES of opponents in a small AoE by 20%. This effect cannot be stacked.

Brings a falling meteor down to earth, dealing massive Geo DMG to opponents caught in its AoE and applying the Petrification status to them.

Petrification

passives.name: Resonant Waves

When the Jade Shield takes DMG, it will Fortify:
·Fortified characters have 5% increased Shield Strength.
Can stack up to 5 times, and lasts until the Jade Shield disappears.

passives.name: Dominance of Earth
passives.description:
Zhongli deals bonus DMG based on his Max HP:
·Normal Attack, Charged Attack, and Plunging Attack DMG is increased by 1.39% of Max HP.
·Dominus Lapidis' Stone Stele, resonance, and hold DMG is increased by 1.9% of Max HP.
·Planet Befall's DMG is increased by 33% of Max HP.

constellations.caveat: Not modeled: the heal when the Jade Shield takes a hit (40% of that DMG, capped at 8% of Max HP) — incoming DMG isn't simulated.
_curatorNotes: Caveat-only (capability sweep 2026-07-28): gcsim shield.go:73-93 (shd.OnDamage) — heal = 0.4 * incident dmg to the active character, capped at 0.08 * MaxHP per instance. Heal value is a function of incoming enemy damage (no fixed scaling%×stat shape) and the trigger (shield taking a hit) has no Effect-trigger primitive, so no heal effect is authorable.
constellations.description:
When the Jade Shield takes DMG, 40% of that incoming DMG is converted to HP for the current character.
A single instance of regeneration cannot exceed 8% of that character's Max HP.
